steps.name: Checking In (1)
steps.objective: Talk to "Parmila" at the "Oscuras Mercenary Camp", then obtain <Hawa's Toy> in the "Sky Castle" and report to [Velita] in "Drulridge".

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: %s, could you lend me a hand?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Nothing much. Do you remember Velita in Drulridge?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. The girl holding lion cubs.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Good. I'm glad you remember.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Glad... Sure, but what's the matter?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Velita's looking for toys for the cubs, but can't find anything suitable.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: They're growing lions. Ordinary toys get destroyed immediately, so she wants something tougher.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Our company can make dog and cat toys in no time, but toys for lions are a bit much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, you make those, too?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Sometimes we sew eyes onto dolls as well.

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: So, any ideas?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing comes to mind... Oh!

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: You've thought of something!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll fetch it. Wait, one probably won't be enough. How many should I bring?

lines.speaker: 파르밀라
lines.text: Five should be plenty. Take them straight to Drulridge, all right? And collect the fee from Velita.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood. See you later.

steps.name: Checking In (2)
steps.objective: Talk to [Rosemary] at the "Jude Kingdom Eastern Borderlands".

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: It's been a while. You must have been busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, a few things came up. I brought the lion cub toys you requested from the mercenaries.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Thank you. I've never seen toys this sturdy.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Looking closely, they seem like gifts someone gave to a loved one... May I really accept something so precious?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's fine. 'He' has plenty of them.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Who is he?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Never mind. Anyway, see you next time.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: You must take your fee.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Parmila told me to, but they weren't difficult to obtain. I don't really want payment.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Hmm... I'd feel bad.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll be going.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Where are you headed?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Lumen. I expect to be working around there in Eastland for a while.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: If you see Rosemary or Frozen on the way, could you give them my regards?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: I don't know exactly where they are, but I heard they're on the Eastern Continent.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do you know them?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: The Demigod Frozen once stayed briefly in our village with Rosemary.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: We had a little trouble then, but thanks to them, it passed without incident.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What happened?

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Before taking office, Libera's corrupt mayor Zekal made a mess of Mushroom Forest. He said the mushrooms were profitable and stripped the place of mushrooms and fruit.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Mirgandia's nature and resources have held special power since ancient times. The mushrooms have that power, too.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: When he harvested so many, parts of the forest began to die.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So Frozen helped restore the forest's strength.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Yes. It isn't as perfect as before, but it can maintain its present state.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for telling me. I'll give Rosemary your regards. She's still in Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But I don't know where Frozen is.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: That's a shame, but it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll ask around, just in case. Take care.

lines.speaker: 벨리타
lines.text: Thank you. Visit Drulridge again, all right?

steps.name: Checking In (3)
steps.objective: Obtain a <Demon Realm Fragment> in the 「Abyss Chamber」, then report to [Rosemary] at the "Jude Kingdom Eastern Borderlands".

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Well, if it isn't the hero of Jude.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, please don't call me that.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Why? You did save the kingdom.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: What brings you here? I heard you've met Lady Iris and been keeping busy.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The reason I'm here is...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You briefly explain recent events and what brought you here.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Hmm... I see.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Velita, that lovely girl, remembers me. That's nice! I wonder when I'll see her again.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Rosemary wears an unusually pleased expression.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you heard anything from Frozen?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Oh, that man? It's been quite a while since he went to the Northern Sea. Probably...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I heard Northern Sea last time, too. Where exactly?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'm not sure. All I know is an icy coast at the far north of this continent. Probably near Debora.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: It's kind of Velita to think of him, but he's no ordinary human. He'll manage fine alone.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: No news is good news. Wait... Something feels odd.

lines.speaker: 메이스
lines.text: Rosemary, are you here? I visited Lumen and found a letter for you, so I brought it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Thanks. But who would write to...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is it from? Why that look?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: That man. Incredible timing. Seems he has something to say to Jude's hero.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Engineering this sort of timing is one of his abilities...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Frozen?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Looks like he has a favor for you. It mentions Iris and your name, %s, so like it or not, you'll have to hear it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Huh? The last part has a mechanism on it. We'll need a particular item to decipher it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Sigh. We'll have to play along.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: If it's about Iris, I have no choice. What do I need to do?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Bring two [Fragments of the Demon Realm]. The name alone sounds ominous. I'd come with you, but he says only you can obtain them...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll go.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: What is Frozen thinking, sealing a letter with something from the Demon Realm?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: They should be back about now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm back. I brought the items.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: So these are them... Chilling just to look at. It's been a while since I handled something with Demon Realm energy...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do we decipher it?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You seem to think all I do is fight, but I came from the Temple of Seres.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I never thought that.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Just joking. Anyway, this much is easy. Wait while I decipher it.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Rosemary places the fragments on the letter. They dissolve, and an unknown light swirls around the paper, revealing previously invisible writing.)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Done. Shall we read it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please read it aloud.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: All right. Let's see. 'Rosemary, and %s... If you're reading this letter, the two of you must be together.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'I'm passing the Northern Sea and Debora, heading toward Avalon in the Dark Holy Kingdom of Deimos.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait... That man... Where did he say he was?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'll keep reading.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'Rosemary is probably reacting with, "Has that man gone mad?"'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Of course I am! Has he gone mad? Going there alone?!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What does the rest say?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wait. Let me calm down. Whew... Continuing.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'There's something I'm curious about. I'll go in and out quickly, so don't worry. There are things I must do for this continent and Goddess Iris.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Frozen always does as he pleases...

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: '%s, I hear you've been meeting the Champions. Continue, and you may lessen the danger from that world approaching ours.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: He seems to know what you've been doing, too.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's a great Demigod. Perhaps it's only natural he knows.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'I'm sorry. I thought Belosh had resolved this, but things suddenly went wrong... Something happened to him. I regret that I can't explain at length.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'Even a Demigod granted a portion of divine authority has things they can and cannot do... At the time, his arrogance kept him from distinguishing them.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'Neither Lydia nor I knew.'

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Belosh, Frozen, Lydia... Demigods from the Temple of Seres?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: None of those are their real names. Everyone calls them that, so I do, too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: I'll continue.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: 'I'll arrange a meeting soon... I'd like to see the goddess as well. And to my beloved Rosemary: don't worry about me. Don't react so violently to that, either.'

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Wh-who's reacting violently?!

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (With those words, Rosemary tears Frozen's letter to shreds.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll head to Lumen now. Thank you for reading the letter, Rosemary.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Oh, you're going to Lumen?

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: Then tell Priest Miya what it said. She records some of the Demigods' activities.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. Take care.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: You too.

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (Hmm. Whatever else, the Deimos cult is plotting something... Could it be?! No, surely not?)

lines.speaker: 로즈마리
lines.text: (And the sanctuary has been quiet lately. Those muscleheaded Saviors will handle it, though...)

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: May our god always be with you... Ah, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Rosemary asked me to come.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Please, tell me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You tell Priest Miya about the letter from the Demigod Frozen.)

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I see. You needn't worry too much.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Even if something serious happens, it's Frozen. He'll resolve it and return quickly.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Please take care as you continue your work, too.

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Oh, that's right, adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes?

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Our order wishes to grant you a helpful title. Would that be acceptable?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Certainly. I'd be grateful...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: Melvic in Tartaros proposed it, and it was approved.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Melvic? If he proposed it...

lines.speaker: 프리스트 미야
lines.text: I think it suits you well. May our god's blessing be with you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: W-wait!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: '%s, the Goddess's Executioner'?! That's ridiculous! What does the order think of me?!
